entries.zh: 万岁（万万岁）；祝颂长命万年的套语，对应西语「愿阁下长命千岁」
entries.en: Long live!; (acclamation of) ten thousand years of life; may Your Grace live a thousand years
entries.notes: M 栏空白；H 栏中字「乙」与 R 栏对音 bān bān 不合，疑为「萬」之误读（当作萬萬歲）；V.mg. 按 17 世纪西语惯例展开为 vuestra merced，系推断。

entries.zh: 寿数；天定的寿命年限（祝人寿数绵长、长命千岁）
entries.en: lifespan; allotted span of years (blessing: may you live a thousand years and see long days)
entries.notes: L 栏字迹残损难辨（疑为 veas largos días 一类祝寿套语），据 H/M「壽數」定释义。

entries.zh: 纳福；受福、享福（承接福分）
entries.en: to receive blessings; to enjoy good fortune
entries.notes: M 栏音注有污损（T99）且仅存「納」音，L 栏亦残损；据 H 栏「納福」定释义。

entries.zh: 夫妻偕老；愿夫妻长寿相守到老（白头偕老）
entries.en: may husband and wife live a thousand years; to grow old together as a married couple

entries.zh: 在；住在、居于（在某处、居留）
entries.en: to be at/in; to dwell, reside (Sp. estar, morar)
to live; to be alive (to have life)
to be born; to bear (children); life
entries.notes: M 栏后段音注污损难辨（T99），或杂有西语 nacer（出生）一类注文；据 H 栏「生」及 seng 音定释义。

entries.zh: 阳间；阳世（生者所居之世，与阴间相对）
entries.en: the world of the living; this life (yang realm, as opposed to the netherworld)
to live in a house; to dwell, stay (lit. stand/stay put)

entries.zh: 立所在；住在一个地方（居于某地、村镇）
entries.en: to live in a place or town; to reside somewhere

entries.zh: 滥做；胡作妄为、生活无度（任意乱来）
entries.en: to live disorderly; to act recklessly/indiscriminately

entries.zh: 行；品行端正地生活、做人行得好（行路、行事）
entries.en: to live well morally; to walk, conduct oneself

entries.zh: 泰；安泰、平安（生活安好，享有太平）
entries.en: peace and ease; to live well and at peace (Sp. tener paz, to have peace)
entries.notes: M 栏音注中杂有西语 tener paz 字样，L 栏释义与 H「泰」对应较松，取安泰平安之义。

entries.zh: 危难；处境危殆、不得安宁（度日多难）
entries.en: peril, distress; to live in danger and without peace

entries.zh: 命带煞；命中带凶煞（旧时星命之说，谓命蹇运滞、夫妻多乖违纠缠）
entries.en: one's fate carries a baleful star; ill-starred destiny bringing discord between husband and wife
entries.notes: L 栏字迹残损难辨（enterrelados 疑为 entrelazados），据 H/M「命帶煞」定释义。

entries.zh: 立平善；安分平和向善地生活（平善度日）
entries.en: to live in peace and goodness; to live peaceably and well

entries.zh: 行平善；行事平和向善（与人和睦、平善度日）
entries.en: to conduct oneself peaceably and well; to live in peace

entries.zh: 生死；生死之事（人生在世即趋死，活如垂死）
entries.en: life and death; to live dying (the mortal condition)
entries.notes: M 栏首音污损难辨（T99），据 H 栏「生死」与 L 栏 Vivir muriendo 定释义。

entries.zh: 守己；安分守己（克己自守、谨守本分度日）
entries.en: to keep to oneself; to live with restraint, minding one's own affairs
entries.notes: M 栏首音污损（T99）；H 栏「已」疑为「己」之误读（安分守己之守己），siu guy 音可证。
